answer: Symbiotic-reef collateral forces sybils to post real estate. Each applicant attaches a reef plot it tends, with public history of who repaired it and how long. A puppet owns none, so it rents, and renters post a higher bond than owners since a plot cannot be pledged twice. If two applicants claim one reef, a prism check splits their light signatures; identical signatures mean one machine and both bonds are forfeited. Each settled applicant owes one ember monthly, so fifty clones pay fifty embers fifty bonds. Honest agents post one plot.
